description.en: Papers on kernel, hypervisor, virtual-device and browser fuzzing, embedded Linux rehosting, and security bug fixes — published at USENIX Security, NDSS, CCS, IEEE S&P, RAID, ASE and more.
description.zh: 内核、hypervisor、虚拟设备与浏览器模糊测试，嵌入式 Linux 内核重托管，以及安全缺陷修复分析——发表于 USENIX Security、NDSS、CCS、IEEE S&P、RAID、ASE 等会议。
